title: Artificial Realities Coral – A
medium: Diasec-mounted Giclee prints on aluminium composite panel

events.q: These will be produced this year ready for delivery January 2026.
The artworks were created using a unique AI model which was trained on ethically-sourced coral reef datasets, marine imaging archives and ecological studies.
Serpentine and Refik Anadol, presents a new limited edition - 'Artificial Realities: Coral'
